title: S force triangular fire team trained on Murchison ranch in Mexico
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of S force triangular fire team trained on Murchison ranch in Mexico, about 1960-1963 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Fort Huachuca, Arizona / Mexico ranch of Clint Murchison Jr.

tellings.quote: So they set up a triangular fire team base down there to to practice shooting a moving target from three different locations

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher on the Kennedy assassination, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that between 1960 and 1963 a group he calls S force, tied to Fort Huachuca, an Army base in Arizona, set up a training base on a Mexican ranch owned by Texas businessman Clint Murchison Jr. There, he says, a team practised shooting a moving target from three different spots at once, and he links the effort to Carl Jenkins and the mobster Santos Trafficante. If true, it would suggest Kennedy's killing was rehearsed in advance.
